_description: Maven dependencies whose POM license list is a choice of licenses (dual or multi licensing), so any one listed license may be chosen. A POM can also list one license per bundled component, and then every listed license applies, so the evaluator treats a list that is not matched here as licenses that all apply. matchType 'prefix' with a trailing ':' matches a whole groupId. An entry changes the result only when the listed licenses differ in category or include an unknown name; otherwise it changes only how the licenses are shown.
